faqs.a:
The city council may budget and appropriate a monetary sum for the purpose of defraying
               the expenses related to continuing judicial education. The availability and approval
               of these funds for individual judges shall be determined by the presiding judge who
               shall report in writing the use of such funds on an annual basis to the city council.
(Code 1981, § 18-46; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
